notes: The only place akuko keeps model ids and prices (plan R-2). Every model carries a last_verified date; `doctor` flags entries older than stale_after_days. billing: free = costs akuko nothing; direct-api = akuko calls a paid HTTP API with the user's key (never on host A in v0.x); connected-mcp = a paid generation tool on a connected MCP server (needs the confirmation line on host A). Entries with example: true are placeholders for tests and for WP-06 to replace: their prices are illustrative, not quotes, and the gate refuses them outside tests.

manual-handoff.source: No cost to akuko: you paste the prompt package into a tool of your choice. Any spend you report when handing the file back is recorded in the ledger.
